title: Thematic structured products portfolio
subtitle: Proposal by the Syz advisory team
objective: Generate a regular, high coupon from the companies and markets we have the strongest convictions on, with a defined level of protection on every product and no single story dominating the portfolio.

1.thesis: Three largest developed markets: diversified market risk, no single-company risk.

2.thesis: Tech leadership, US small caps and Nordic cyclicals: three engines, rate-cut beneficiaries.

3.thesis: Cash-rich mega-caps monetising AI across search, devices and enterprise cloud.

4.thesis: The two largest internet profit pools, advertising and e-commerce, plus cloud.

5.thesis: The three bottlenecks of AI compute: foundry, accelerators, custom chips.

6.thesis: Tool makers behind every new chip fab, with monopoly-like positions.

7.thesis: The leading security platform consolidator; budgets among the last to be cut.

8.thesis: Leaders of US capital markets, levered to the M&A and IPO recovery.

9.thesis: Well-capitalised European banks and Swiss wealth managers with large buybacks.

10.thesis: The plumbing of AI data centres, whichever chips win.

11.thesis: European electrical champions with multi-year grid and data-centre order books.

12.thesis: Oil majors and a power producer: cash returns and energy security.

13.thesis: Gold, copper and uranium miners: hedge, electrification and nuclear revival.

14.thesis: Defensive growth: obesity drugs, drug distribution and diagnostics.

15.thesis: Everyday global brands with pricing power and the lowest volatility.

16.thesis: European aircraft and engine makers with decade-long order books.

17.thesis: The highest-quality luxury names, first in line for a demand recovery.

18.thesis: Toll-road financials: payment networks and the largest asset manager.
